"Create a mobile-playable 2.5D real-time strategy game: 3D-rendered isometric world with a fixed angled camera, gameplay on a 2D grid.

Concept:
- Player commands a small colony on a floating island in a futuristic fantasy setting.
- Match goal: destroy the enemy base before the enemy destroys yours.

2.5D visuals:
- Fixed isometric camera (approx. 45° rotation, 35° tilt) with pan and pinch-zoom.
- Grid-based map (24x24 tiles) with elevation variation, 3D buildings and units, and fog of war.
- Dynamic lighting, unit shadows, animated water/cloud edges around the island.

Economy:
- 2 resources: Energy (from generators) and Crystal (from mines on crystal nodes).
- Starting resources: 300 Energy, 200 Crystal.
- Passive income per generator/mine, shown in the HUD.

Buildings:
- Command Center (main base; losing it means defeat).
- Generator, Crystal Mine, Barracks, Defense Tower, Research Lab.
- Placement on valid tiles only, with a green/red placement preview.
- Build time with a progress bar.

Units:
- 4 types: Worker (builds, gathers), Soldier (melee), Archer (ranged), Siege (long-range, strong vs buildings).
- Counter system: Soldier > Archer > Siege > Soldier.
- Each unit has health, damage, speed, range, and cost.

Controls (mobile):
- Tap to select; drag-box or \"select all army\" button for groups.
- Tap ground to move; tap enemy to attack.
- Bottom build/train panel with large icons (min 64px).
- Two-finger pan, pinch to zoom.
- Minimap in a corner.

Enemy AI:
- Builds economy, trains mixed armies, attacks in waves every 90 seconds.
- 3 difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard.
- Scouts and retreats when outnumbered.

Systems:
- A* pathfinding with obstacle avoidance.
- Research Lab upgrades: +damage, +health, +gather speed.
- Population cap of 30 units, raised by a building.

UI:
- Top bar: Energy, Crystal, population.
- Selected unit/building info panel.
- Pause menu, win and lose screens with restart.

Style:
- Low-poly art, colors: teal and gold for player, crimson and black for enemy, on a soft sky-blue background.
- Effects: build dust, projectile trails, hit sparks, destruction explosion.
- Simple sound effects: build, train, attack, win, defeat.

Performance:
- 60 FPS on mid-range phones with up to 60 units on screen.
- Lightweight assets, no external loading.

Delivery:
- Complete, playable game with no errors and no placeholder content.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
